policy_title: Promote child-friendly app restricted smartphones and investigate social media harms
stated: Reform UK will promote child-friendly app restricted smartphones, launch an inquiry into social media harms due to its association with eating disorders, anxiety, depression, suicide, and the child mental health crisis.

source.quote: Promote Child Friendly App Restricted Smartphones Social media is associated with eating disorders, anxiety, depression, suicide and the child mental health crisis. Launch an inquiry into social media harms.

bearing_set.reason: The policy explicitly targets child mental health outcomes — eating disorders, anxiety, depression, suicide — which directly bear on mental health access and capacity, a core O3 indicator; both the inquiry and the restricted-phone promotion are levers aimed at reducing demand on mental health services and improving child mental health.

Promoting app-restricted smartphones signals state-endorsed content restrictions on children's devices, and an inquiry oriented toward harm-regulation points toward future speech/expression restrictions; the mechanism (limiting what content children can access or express via devices) is concrete even if the current measure is pre-regulatory.

membership_note: Two genuine bearings: O3 is the primary target (child mental health crisis is an explicit healthcare indicator); O10 is a real secondary bearing because the stated direction of travel — restricting app access — implicates freedom of expression and state coercion even at the 'promote and investigate' stage, where the mechanism is identifiable. No material bearing on O1, O2, O4–O9, O11–O15 at the level of this policy as stated.
